definitions.explanation: A mistake where something important is missed or not noticed. Refers to the act of overlooking or to the thing that was missed.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}に{見落|みお}としがないか{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: Check the documents for any oversights.

examples.japanese: {小|ちい}さな{見落|みお}としが{大|おお}きなミスにつながることがある。
examples.english: A small oversight can lead to a big mistake.

examples.japanese: {何度|なんど}も{読|よ}み{返|かえ}したが、それでも{見落|みお}としがあった。
examples.english: I reread it many times, but there were still things I missed.

notes:
Noun form derived from the verb {見落|みお}とす (to overlook, to miss). Commonly used in work and professional contexts when checking for errors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見落|みお}としがある (there is an oversight)
- {見落|みお}としがないか{確認|かくにん}する (check for oversights)
- {重大|じゅうだい}な{見落|みお}とし (a serious oversight)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {見逃|みのが}し: missing something (can imply intentionally letting it pass)
- ミス: mistake (broader, includes all types of errors)
